preconditions.description: The number of queries Q is between 1 and 400000, inclusive.
The root node index R is between 1 and the current count of nodes cnt, inclusive.
The weight W of a new node is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
The maximum sum of weights X in a sequence is between 1 and 10^15, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: Output the maximum length of sequence of nodes which starts with R, every node in the sequence is an ancestor of its predecessor, sum of weight of nodes in sequence does not exceed X, and for some nodes i, j that are consecutive in the sequence if i is an ancestor of j then w[i] ≥ w[j] and there should not exist a node k on simple path from i to j such that w[k] ≥ w[j].
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum length of a valid sequence of nodes starting with R with the given constraints.
